title: YZF-R3 Monster Energy (Rally Edition)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Middleweight Sportbike capability, the Yamaha YZF-R3 Monster Energy (Rally Edition) delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Focused on closed-course control and sporting precision, its Aggressive Forward Tuck posture pairs with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort to optimize high-speed aerodynamic stability.
